notes:
What's new in 1.4:
• ⬆ Import now works with your own spreadsheet layout. OptionIQ guesses which column is which, you fix any wrong guess from drop-down lists, and you see a preview before anything is saved
• Understands words like Put/Call, Sell/Buy, Sell to Open, Closed and Expired, picks the right sheet in an Excel file, and skips totals rows
• Clear Add and Replace buttons, and your column choices are remembered for next time

New in 1.3.2:
• New versions are offered as soon as you start the app
• Updates are much faster, show an "Updating OptionIQ" window and reopen the app by themselves

New in 1.3:
• Screener gives each trade a 0–100 Score and lists the best first (hover over the Score to see why)
• Weekly and Monthly quick settings in the Screener
• New 🔁 Roll candidates: shows roll choices for your open puts and calls, with your own settings for days, delta, in the money, and puts or calls
• Premiums shown after the $0.67 fee
• Warnings for upcoming dividends, too much in one sector, and price support levels
• The price message at the top can now be closed with ✕
